en.description:
Pixel Snake brings the timeless arcade classic to iPhone — pure, fast and beautifully retro.

EAT. GROW. SURVIVE.
Guide your snake to the food, grow longer, and don't bite your tail. Simple to learn, impossible to put down.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Classic solo mode with progressive speed
• Versus AI — three difficulty levels, from chill to ruthless
• Two players on ONE device — face-off across the screen, each with their own controls
• Swipe, D-Pad or motion controls

MAKE IT YOURS
• 8 background themes, 10 snake colors, 4 snake styles
• Prize food mode for risk/reward strategy
• Adjustable grid size and speed

COMPETE
• Game Center leaderboard and 26 achievements
• Local top 15 high scores
• Apple Watch app with Digital Crown controls — scores sync via iCloud

---
